question.worked_solution:
We simplify each of the radical terms using the product rule:

$$
\begin{aligned}3\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{27}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-\sqrt{{x}^{5}} & = \\ 3\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{9\cdot 3}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-\sqrt{{x}^{4}\cdot x} & = \\ 3\sqrt{3}-\sqrt{9}\cdot \sqrt{3}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-\sqrt{{x}^{4}}\cdot \sqrt{x} & = \\ 3\sqrt{3}-3\sqrt{3}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-{x}^{2}\sqrt{x} & \end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we combine the like terms:

$$
\begin{aligned}3\sqrt{3}-3\sqrt{3}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-{x}^{2}\sqrt{x} & = \\ (3-3)\sqrt{3}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-{x}^{2}\sqrt{x} & = \\ 0\cdot \sqrt{3}+3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-{x}^{2}\sqrt{x} & = \\ 3\sqrt[3]{{x}^{2}}-{x}^{2}\sqrt{x} & \end{aligned}
$$
